verdict.rationale: Conductor's own changelog announces routines that run agents on a schedule or via GitHub action, which is a recurring background automation rather than a one-off run. Cloud sandboxes keep agents working after the laptop is closed, and agents can run builds without per-step confirmation. However, routines are evidenced only by a single changelog line, with no detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth routine documentation (schedule configuration, trigger options, management or monitoring of runs, failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration that routines run unattended as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
